description: Every Defender 300Tdi is different. That's why we offer the right solution for your engine, your car and your budget.

cards.title: REBUILDING YOUR 300TDI ENGINE
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Defender already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component (injectors, head gasket, cooling system and timing belt) with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most Defender 300Tdi owners choose, and it's the one we'd recommend for most situations.

cards.title: REPLACEMENT 300TDI ENGINES
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month warranty.

cards.title: USED 300TDI ENGINES
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries. Enter your reg below and we'll talk you through both options honestly.

banner.title: NOT SURE WHICH OPTION IS RIGHT FOR YOU?
banner.body: Enter your registration below and we'll confirm your 300Tdi and talk you through the best solution for your Defender 300Tdi, honestly.
